author: Stahly
description:
I used to think that drybrush paints were a waste of money, because why bother when regular paint does the job just as well. But after testing all the Warhammer Color Dry paints, plus all the Green Stuff World, Ionic and Dio drybrush paints for this video, I changed my mind. At least, somewhat. I’ll tell you everything you need to know about drybrush paints, which ones are actually worth it, and how to get the best results out of them.

The post All you need to know about Drybrush paints (every brand compared) appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: All you need to know about Drybrush paints (every brand compared)
